label: command-line switch -nologo
domain: present or absent; any argument whose eight bytes are exactly -nologo with its terminator, compared byte by byte (0x0022BE40-0x0022BE52), so -NOLOGO or -nologo2 do not count; more than one copy acts as one
precedence: the first-start flag 0x022C2528 has two other writers, and both also store 1: verb 0x5A8 (0x003500F0), which the title loop of ttl_a01 runs after its start-up pages (main step 17), and the zone restore path 0x00314530 (0x003145C5); nothing stores 0
takes_effect: once per launch, in the init job (0x00314DE0(1) from 0x0022BDF0), before the title screen script runs
consumers: verb 0x5A7 isFirstStartDone (0x0034FDA0, through 0x00314930), which the title screen script ttl_a01 tests (main steps 8, 11 and 14)
visible_effect: the first title screen of a launch comes without the SQUARE ENIX logo and the autosave notice, which the title loop shows only while isFirstStartDone() is 0
inert_when: for every later visit to the title screen in the same launch: the title loop's verb 0x5A8 or the restore path has already set the flag

label: second command-line argument debug
domain: the exact bytes debug with their terminator as the second argument (0x00D121F8, compared at 0x00408DA1-0x00408DC2), with at least two arguments
precedence: overrides the FF12CONFIG start-up field: 0x00408C30 first copies the file's u16 at +0x0A to 0x02B62DB4, then stores 0 there (0x00408DC4)
takes_effect: when the settings file is loaded at start-up (0x00408C30)
consumers: the start-up field selection (0x003318C4-0x003318FE), which reads 0x02B62DB4 only while 0x02B62DAD is 1
visible_effect: no visible change in the shipped game
inert_when: always in the shipped game: 0x02B62DAD is 1 only when 0x01E02804 is not negative, and it is -1 in the image
